env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^2$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/methodparen

go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Box[T any] struct {
	Items []T
}

func (b Box[T]) Count() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n
}

type Pair struct {
	A int
	B string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println((Box[Pair]{}.Count)())
}
